Photo Video Maker Online 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Transform JPG, PNG, HEIC, and WebP photos into 1080p MP4 slideshow videos in 30–60 seconds via cloud GPUs.
- Handles uploads up to 200MB; supports mixed media including video and audio clips.
- Includes authentication workflow with automatic token creation and session management.
- Streamlined action mapping for uploading, editing, viewing credits, exporting videos, and tracking status.
- Robust error handling and clear user feedback for common issues like token expiry, missing headers, or unsupported files.
- Designed for shareable video creation, targeting social media creators and everyday users.
